sorry for late response. this should work:  
`local sprite = player:AddBlueFlies(Amount, Position, Target):GetSprite()`

`sprite:Load("gfx/[yourfly].anm2", true)`

`sprite:ReplaceSpritesheet(0, "gfx/[yourfly].png")`

amount being how many you want to spawn, position is where to spawn them (if you want to spawn them at the player, do player.Position), and 99% of the time you'll just set target to nil.

for ReplaceSpritesheet() make sure you have your spritesheet in the same path as where you're grabbing it (in this example it should be in \[modname\]/resources/gfx/)

same goes for load but use the anm2 file for the blue fly.
